topic: Minato had a way to end the Nine-Tails threat completely that night (Kushina's offer to reseal it into herself) and rejected it on purpose
title: Minato Rejected Kushina's Plan To End The Nine-Tails
description: Right before sealing the Nine-Tails into Naruto, Kushina offers a different plan: reseal it into herself so it ends that same night. Minato says no, and the reason he gives changes how this whole scene should be read. From the full story: Minato Sealed The Nine-Tails Inside Naruto On Purpose.
comment: Was Minato protecting Naruto that night, or already recruiting him for a war to come? Pick one.

lines.text: Minato had a way to end the Nine-Tails for good that night. He said no.
